type.title: Content of tray {floor}

err.activeOrder: An order is running on this tray and the PLC is reading it right now. Stop production and repeat.
err.extracted: Tray out or moving. With the tray open, declare it from the robot page (Reset cell state); from here it is done with the tray closed.
err.noPiece: Invalid part code: it does not exist. Pick one from the list.
err.tooBig: The chosen part does not fit these pockets: it overlaps the neighbouring pocket by {pitch} mm and sticks out of the tray by {over} mm. The robot would hit it. Use a part of the right size, or regenerate the grid for this part.
err.thickness: The chosen part is picked too low for this grating: pick height {pick} mm and place height {place} mm are below the minimum {min} mm. The gripper would touch the grid.
err.generic: Declaration failed. Try again; if it happens again, call support.

layout.dupRows: ANOMALY on tray {floor}: {n} duplicated rows in the database (same SUB_POS). Only one position per SUB_POS is shown — clean [POSITION] before producing: duplicates skew the PLC count.

reset.title: Reset the state of tray {floor}?
reset.what: All {n} positions of the tray are set to RAW PRESENT (status 4) and released from any order (Order_ID = 0).
reset.warn: This DECLARES the tray full of raw parts: use it ONLY after physically reloading it. If the positions are empty, the robot will try to pick where there is nothing.
reset.done: Tray state reset: {n} positions set to raw, orders released.
reset.activeOrder: An order is in progress: stop production before resetting the tray.

composition.title: Fixture composition
composition.note: The Z above is the plane the part rests on in the vice, and it is the only value the PLC reads to place in the machine. Declaring what it is made of is what makes it possible to see whether that sum adds up.
composition.afterSave: Composition changed: the sum of the parts is recomputed when you save.
composition.divergeWhy: The declared height ({dichiarata} mm) does not match the parts (pallet {pallet} + vice {morsa} = {somma} mm).
composition.divergeWhat: The PLC uses the declared height: the robot will place at that height. Fix it from Edit.
composition.divergeUses: The PLC uses the declared height: the robot will place at {dichiarata} mm, not at {somma} mm.
composition.undeclaredWhat: Where the height comes from is unknown: declare pallet and vice from Edit.
composition.undeclaredForm: The composition of this fixture has not been declared. It is not an error, but while it is missing nobody can notice if the declared height stops matching the parts.
composition.alignAction: Align the height to the sum
composition.alignWhat: The declared height goes from {dichiarata} mm to {somma} mm.
composition.alignUp: The machine placing point moves {mm} mm HIGHER.
composition.alignDown: The machine placing point moves {mm} mm LOWER.
composition.alignThenSave: Confirming only changes the field: the robot moves when you save.

teach.title: Tray-rack teaching (command 0)
teach.chooseSample: Choose the SAMPLE tray: teaching is done once on it, the other 11 are derived automatically.

teach.zPickInvalid: The part in position 1 has Z pick 0: it is the pick height from the floor and must be greater than 0. Fix the part registry before teaching.
teach.lockedHint: Editing reserved to the technician level
teach.rotHint: Pick rotations: uniform for the whole tray rack.
teach.preview: PREVIEW — the corrections of ALL trays will be written. Check before confirming.
teach.noTrayRow: tray not in DB: row skipped
teach.writeOk: Teaching written to the whole tray rack
teach.writeErr: Write FAILED: no change applied (transaction rolled back)
teach.applied: Approach and rotations applied to {n} tray positions

assoc.extractedHint: Tray extracted or moving: operation not allowed
assoc.sourceHint: Pockets will be COPIED from a tray already taught with the same grating (suggested: the one with the most pockets in the database).
assoc.willCopy: The {k} taught pockets of tray {n} will be copied.
assoc.generateHint: No taught tray with this grating: pockets will be GENERATED from the model header on this tray size.
assoc.regenerateHint: Pockets will be RECOMPUTED from the model header: the taught coordinates of this tray will be lost.
assoc.willDelete: The {k} current pockets of tray {n} will be deleted.

err.noModel: The grating of this tray no longer exists in the catalog: use Replace.
err.noPiece: What the tray will contain has not been declared: without a part code the pockets would be invisible to the cycle. Pick it above.
err.emptyGrid: No pocket can be generated with these sizes.
err.outOfTray: Grid OUTSIDE the tray outline (exceeds by {w} mm along Y, {h} mm along X): no pocket written.
err.extracted: Refused: the tray appears extracted or moving (TRAY.EXTRACT). If it is inside, the PLC did not update the state.
err.activeOrder: Refused: a pocket of the tray is linked to an ACTIVE order.
err.alreadyAssociated: Refused: the tray already has a grating or pockets in the database. Use Replace.
err.sourceEmpty: Refused: the source tray has no pockets or uses another grating.
err.zPick: Part {id} of the model has Z pick 0 (pick height from the floor): every generated pocket would be ungrippable. Fix the part registry.
err.thickness: Refused: pick height {pick} mm / release {place} mm below the minimum {min} mm (grid thickness {t} + 1 clearance). Fix the part Z pick/Z place, or the grating thickness.

grating.name: Name
grating.refPartHint: Optional: which part these pockets were measured on. It is not the tray content — that is declared when the grating is associated, and changed from the tray page.
grating.delete: The model will be deleted (no tray uses it).

cavity.title: Cavity clearance for the manufacturing file
cavity.hint: TOTAL play added to the size of each cavity (half per side, centre unchanged). Default {def} mm; 0 = no clearance; maximum {max} mm. Applies only to DXF and print: the saved grating and the SVG model stay nominal.
cavity.label: Cavity clearance
cavity.rangeError: Invalid value: enter a number between 0 and {max} mm (one decimal).

grating.taughtMismatch: WARNING: the tray positions in the database were TAUGHT in the cell (real pitches {realW} / {realH} mm) and do NOT match the ones that will be regenerated ({genW} / {genH} mm). The robot works on the current coordinates: overwriting them can cause a COLLISION. Regenerate anyway?
grating.outOfTray: Grid OUTSIDE the tray contour: {detail}. Save cancelled, no pocket written.
grating.deleteInUse: Grating used by trays {floors}: dissociate them first from the Trays page.
grating.inUse: Delete refused: the grating is used by at least one tray. Dissociate it first from the Trays page.
grating.catalogHint: Model catalog. A grating has no pockets: it is associated to trays from the Trays page.
grating.modelHint: Preview on the drawer unit size: {w} × {h} mm. Association to trays is done from the Trays page.
grating.traySizesDiffer: WARNING: trays do not all share the same size: the preview is valid for the reference tray only.
grating.dupName: A grating named "{name}" already exists: the name must be unique.
grating.thicknessHint: mm; empty = not measured, no constraint. With a value, the part pick and release heights must be at least 1 mm above it.
grating.thicknessWarn: Part below the thickness: minimum {min} mm (thickness + 1 clearance), requested pick {pick} mm and release {place} mm. Fix the part or the thickness: pocket generation will be refused.

robot.alarm_22: Gripper presence mismatch between data and sensors
robot.alarm_934: Command refused: auxiliaries not reset. Press the reset and retry.
robot.alarm_936: Gripper deposit refused: no gripper is registered in the system. Check the last load outcome or run the gripper realignment.
robot.alarm_938: Gripper mismatch: the gripper-mounted sensor disagrees with the declared system state. Check that the gripper is properly mounted (or removed), then run "Reset cell state" to re-declare.
robot.alarm_937: Gripper swap refused: invalid target gripper.
robot.alarm_939: Gripper swap refused: requested gripper is already mounted.
robot.alarm_943: Gripper swap: phase timeout (deposit or pick). Check the robot and retry after reset.
robot.alarm_991: Robot: part not found in tray (check order and pocket status in DB)
robot.alarm_944: Invalid content declaration: gripper side does not exist or pallet on both sides
robot.alarm_945: Declaration inconsistent with the sensor: check the mounted gripper
robot.alarm_947: Machine declaration refused: cycle active or pallet already declared
robot.alarm_4099: Pallet coordinates not found in database

declErr.947: Cell not at rest: the PLC does not record declarations while something is moving. Put the cell in HOLD and repeat.
declErr.948: Invalid part: the declared ID does not exist. Pick one from the list and repeat.
declErr.99: Tray number out of range: the PLC accepts 1 to 12, or "no tray out". Pick one from the list.
declErr.996: The declared tray does not match the sensors: this command is a confirmation, not an override. Look at which tray is really out and declare that one.
declErr.997: Robot on a mission: the tray cannot be declared while the robot is working. Wait for the mission to end and repeat.
declErr.999: More than one tray is out: this is a physical anomaly and the PLC cannot pick one. Close the extra trays by hand and repeat.
declErr.944: Content declared on a side that does not exist: the mounted gripper has no such side. Leave it empty and repeat.
declErr.945: Gripper declaration does not match the sensor: the sensor sees a different gripper than the one selected. Check which gripper is mounted and declare that one.
declErr.946: Database error on the PLC: the declaration was not recorded. Repeat; if it happens again, call support.
declErr.20001: No tray is out: pockets can only be corrected on the tray that is out. Extract the tray and repeat.
declErr.20002: Invalid pocket position: that pocket does not exist in this tray. Pick one from the drawing.
declErr.20005: Pocket state not allowed: the PLC only accepts empty, raw or finished.
declErr.20006: Raw declared with no active order: the pocket would be invisible to the cycle and nobody would pick it. Activate the order and repeat, or declare the pocket empty.

decl.title: Reset cell state (manual declaration)
decl.hint: To be used after an emergency, once homing is complete.
decl.bareHint: No gripper detected by the sensor: declare the bare flange.
decl.noEcho: No confirmation from the PLC: check and retry
decl.trayTypeHint: The part code of every pocket in this tray. The pockets below say HOW MUCH is in it; this says WHAT.
decl.trayTypeTooBig: The chosen part does not fit these pockets: it overlaps the neighbour by {pitch} mm and sticks out of the tray by {over} mm. Command not sent.
decl.mcHint: Declare the part that is physically in the vice right now. If the vice is free, leave "Vice empty".
decl.boxHint: This is a confirmation, not an override: the PLC accepts it only if the twelve tray sensors agree. If it does not match, close or extract the right tray.
decl.pocketsNoTray: No tray is out: pockets can only be corrected on the tray that is out.
decl.pocketsNotHold: Cell not idle: the PLC accepts pocket corrections only with the cell in HOLD.

vice.clawLength: Jaw: length along the direction the part slides to the stop
vice.clawLengthHint: Physical measurement with a caliper, in mm. Needed by the push-to-stop cycle: empty = not measured, the cycle stays disabled.
vice.stopsHint: A part longer than the jaw is not an error: it rests further along, on another reference. Declare how far that reference sits beyond the end of the jaw, measured with a caliper. vice.stopsOverhang: {piece} mm long, overhangs {over} mm per side

lastData.title: Order details
lastData.partProgramMissing: The part has no part program: set it in the part master data before creating the order
lastData.pushNoVice: Push to stop is on for this part, but there is no vice on the pallet: the cycle cannot run.
lastData.pushNoData: Push to stop is on, but a measurement is missing: the vice jaw length or the gripper claw length. Complete the registry before creating the order.
lastData.pushNoFit: The part is {piece} mm long and the vice jaw is {claw} mm: the part overhangs, and nobody declared where it really rests. Declare it on the vice page.

lastData.quantityMissing: Enter how many times the part must be produced: with 0 the order cannot be created.
lastData.geometryMissing: The pallet has no geometry (associated fixture): without it the robot does not know the drop height in the machine. Complete the rig before creating the order.
lastData.saveFailed: Order NOT created: refused by the backend.

pushSim.title: Push to stop — simulation
pushSim.intro: Shows what the robot will do after placing the part in the vice. Top view, oriented the way you see the cell standing in front of it: the robot X axis grows to the left, and the part is pushed leftwards to the stop.
pushSim.measuresEdit: Editable values: drawing and quotes update immediately. Nothing typed here is saved.
pushSim.measuresRead: Real values read from the database, read only.
pushSim.stopMissing: The part overhangs the jaw and nobody declared where it really rests. Until that is declared the order is refused.
pushSim.diverged: Values changed: the drawing no longer represents the data on the database.
pushSim.saveHint: Measurements are saved from here, one at a time, with a confirmation naming the physical object you are redefining. Every change is recorded in the cell journal.
pushSim.confirmVice: You are changing the jaw length of vice {obj} from {from} to {to}.
pushSim.confirmGripper: You are changing the claw length of gripper {obj} from {from} to {to}.
pushSim.confirmPiece: You are changing the size of part {obj} from {from} to {to}.
pushSim.confirmPieceWarn: The dimension along the push is also the pocket pitch in the grating: changing it here changes the grids generated from now on.
pushSim.confirmStop: You are changing, for part {piece} on vice {obj}, the distance of the real rest point beyond the end of the jaw from {from} to {to}.
pushSim.confirmStopDelete: You are removing the rest point declaration for part {piece} on vice {obj}.
pushSim.confirmStopDeleteWarn: From now on orders with that part on that vice are refused, until someone declares again where it rests.
pushSim.saveError: Save failed: the value was NOT changed.
pushSim.saveNotFound: The row to update no longer exists: reload the page and try again.
pushSim.restsOnClaw: The part rests on the end of the jaw.
pushSim.restsOnDeclared: The part overhangs the jaw and rests on the declared reference, {mm} mm beyond the end of the jaw.
pushSim.pushOff: Push to stop is not enabled on this part: this shows what would happen if it were.
pushSim.viewStale: Parameters were changed: the row read from the view no longer describes this drawing.

reason.OK: The part is pushed {over} mm from the place position to the stop.
reason.DISABLED: The push cycle is not enabled.
reason.NO_VICE: There is no vice on the pallet: the cycle cannot run.
reason.NO_DATA: A physical measurement is missing: the vice jaw, the gripper claw or the part size.
reason.NO_FIT: The part is {piece} mm long and the jaw is {claw} mm: it overhangs {over} mm per side, and nobody declared where it really rests. Declare it on the vice page.
reason.NO_ROOM: The part overhangs {over} mm per side, but the rest point is declared {stop} mm from the end of the jaw: the part would be past the stop before being pushed at all.
